correctness.rationale: For −1≤η<1 and positive b,γ,v the finite internal chain is irreducible with uniform stationarity; odd sector generator is γ[[-1,η],[1,−1]]. Stationary moments kR=v(b+γ)/(2((b+γ)²−γ²η)), kT=γ kR/(b+γ), C0=v kR/b give closed 3×3 lag covariance ODE. If η≥0, force autocovariance is positive and convolution with positive e^(−b|t|)/(2b) stays positive. If η<0, complex roots −γ±iγsqrt(−η) dominate when b>γ, while for b<γ the e^(−bt) residue is strictly positive; at b=γ exact factorization establishes alternating intervals and first zero at π/(γsqrt(−η)). Independent direct matrix exponentiation checked 72 points. The proof establishes infinitely many intervals, not all finite-lag sign changes for b<γ.
